notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to any creature you control without summoning sickness.
You control an additional permanent that can tap to produce {R}.
description:
Cast Hidden Strings with any targets.
Pay {R} and tap the creature enchanted with Dual Casting to copy Hidden Strings, targeting the creature enchanted with Dual Casting and a permanent that can tap for {R}.
Twinning Staff triggers, creating a copy of Hidden Strings.
The copy targets at least the permanent.
Allow the first copy of Hidden Strings to resolve.
Tap the permanent for {R}.
Repeat steps 2-6.
